theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Asian Bonds Under Pressure as Oil Extends Advance: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian bonds followed Treasuries lower as renewed geopolitical tensions drove oil prices higher, fueling inflation concerns and expectations for further monetary tightening.

top_news.title: Japan’s Companies Boost Capital Investment as Profits Surge
top_news.summary: Japanese companies raised capital spending in the second quarter as profits surged, in the latest sign that the corporate sector is coping fairly well with the fallout from the Middle East conflict.

top_news.title: ‘First Real Test’: Australia Property Fiasco Puts Private Credit on Edge
top_news.summary: Australian private credit funds are trying to contain panic among investors, after the collapse of property developer Bathla Group sparked fears that the industry’s big bet on the property sector is going south.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 1
top_news.summary: Oil rose for a second session as fresh hostilities between the US and Iran raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Gold Holds Decline as Mideast Flare-Up Raises Fed Rate-Hike Bets
top_news.summary: Gold steadied after a two-day drop as the US and Iran exchanged strikes for the first time in a month, raising the odds of rising energy costs pushing up inflation and pressuring the Federal Reserve to lift interest rates.

top_news.title: Bessent Tells Japan Officials Rate Hikes Needed, NHK Says
top_news.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama and Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda that the Asian country’s next step should be to raise interest rates, NHK reports, citing an interview with a US official.

top_news.title: Australia’s Beetaloo Shale Gas Could Power Northern Territory AI Data Centers
top_news.summary: Australia’s Northern Territory started commercial production from the nation’s first shale gas wells, as the sparsely populated region bets on the fossil fuel to power a wave of new data centers.

top_news.title: US Funds Alcoa Gallium Plant in Australia to Cut China Reliance
top_news.summary: The US Department of War said it will provide $174 million in financing to Alcoa Corp. to build a gallium plant at its alumina refinery in Western Australia, as Washington seeks to reduce its reliance on China for critical minerals.

top_news.title: UK Shop Price Inflation Hits Two-Year High After Energy Spike
top_news.summary: Prices in British shops rose at the fastest rate in more than two years last month, as the fallout from the Middle East conflict started to filter through to supermarket shelves.
